next_decisive_experiment.contrast: 先复用旧精确事件与定量基线，对一个来源清楚的事件族提取发布当时可知的方向/变化/预期差，比较price或simple-surprise-only、text-only、combined；同事件、风险、entry时点、horizon、成本，matched event-type shuffle与文本缺失fallback控制。
next_decisive_experiment.depth: 三个信息深度点：忠实复现原事件定义及精确可见时点；从简单词典/数值差到有根据的结构化语义；足够独立事件日/市场状态与未污染验证。最小决定性对照后只对有实际效应的角色加深，不堆模型。
next_decisive_experiment.identify: 发布后短时反应与较慢持有期必须事前固定、分开估计（例如源研究指定的即期与延迟期，不按旧d5正号选最优）。若combined不能超过matched quantitative基线，或shuffle/缺失同效，就没有LLM增量；语义提取准确性另验，不能以解释流畅替代收益。
next_decisive_experiment.stop: 没有事件原文/当时预期或模型训练截止证明，依赖DS/付费源、只剩generic tone或与已规划acceleration同义时暂缓；没有验证分区/独立事件日则not_at_depth，不追加调用刷数。

原负结果不能裁决事件方向/意外程度/受影响对象语义；但后续LLM新闻动量重排确有1451次已完成调用，CLEAN仅5次月末形成、L-B Sharpe−0.238531，随机P/R优于L。此局部重排不值得按新名字再做。

three_economic_depth_points.economic_endpoint: Paired C2−Q2 and C2−C1 forecast and net return difference with adequate date/issuer power plus valid placebo; no complexity credit if BoW or missing fallback matches.
three_economic_depth_points.required_contrast: On same full body/security/clock/label, N0 simple disclosed changes, Q1 price, Q2 quantitative+simple event, B1 TF-IDF, frozen base and large embeddings, C1/C2 combined. Vary information layer and representation capacity while common eligibility stays fixed; audit truncation and effective df.

three_economic_depth_points.economic_endpoint: Positive costed host incremental dollars, uncertainty, drawdown/recovery and actual capital path on a genuinely eligible forward/unseen cohort; 2024–26 R cannot be resealed. If execution data absent, only conditional sensitivity and not_at_depth.
three_economic_depth_points.required_contrast: Predetermined D1 secondary vs D2 primary under Figure5 decay, continuous common calendar, 20k integer shares, quotes/open fill, then-date ETB, financing and operational latency.

calendar_recipe.initial_train: 2024-01-01–2024-12-31 only mature labels at each fit cutoff
calendar_recipe.inner_validation: Two full calendar months immediately before outer quarter with five exchange-session purge at training/validation boundary; training earlier accepted/mature events only. Freeze exact date boundaries, fit cutoff, vocabulary/scaler/alpha and eligible hash per fold before price read. Choose λ on validation MSE, refit only prior mature labels; no current test result.
calendar_recipe.no_label_leak: Every row in train, validation, and final refit must have label_visible<=specific fit cutoff; predictions require fit_finished<=decision. Shared issuer document revisions/clusters stay within split or are purged.

validation.issuer_generalization: 20% issuer-hash subset is trained-in subgroup stress only, not held-out issuer generalization. A genuine issuer-exclusion fit needs separate preregistration and admission.
validation.partition_class: 2024–2026 repeatedly seen research history R only. Chronological out-of-fit predictions are not researcher-unseen OOS; no selectable promotion and no newly sealed OOS.
validation.power: Only after accepted complete event/entry inventory: report independent entry dates, issuer/event-cluster overlap, autocorrelation-adjusted n_eff and paired-net MDE at 80% power/two-sided5%. S0 626 acceptance dates are not 626 independent trading dates or proof of power. Underpowered => N/A/not_at_depth.
